title: Christmas Coloring Pages, 20 Bold and Easy Winter Woodland Coloring Pages for Kids & Adults, Cozy Fox Owl Deer Printable pdf
description:
Twenty cozy Christmas and winter woodland coloring pages with thick, bold outlines and big, easy spaces to fill. Print them tonight and color with your kids, your class, or on your own with a mug of cocoa: a fox in a striped scarf, an owl under a crescent moon, a hedgehog with hot chocolate, a lantern-lit cabin in the snow and sixteen more.

Bold and easy means thick outlines (about 2 mm when printed), every space closed and big enough for crayons, colored pencils and markers, and no tiny fiddly details. Great for little hands, and relaxing for grown-ups who want a calm, low-detail page. There is no text on the pages and each design has its own page.

THE 20 PAGES
1 Fox in a scarf · 2 Owl on a snowy pine · 3 Moonlit deer · 4 Mushrooms in snow · 5 Lantern-lit cabin · 6 Hedgehog with a mug · 7 Robin on holly · 8 Bunny and sled · 9 Bear with a gift · 10 Squirrel and pinecones · 11 Walking home with a tree · 12 Woodland wreath · 13 Snowman and birds · 14 Mouse by candlelight · 15 Birdhouse in snow · 16 Tree in the clearing · 17 Fireplace stockings · 18 Reindeer with a wreath · 19 Hare under the moon · 20 Woodland gnome

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 20 coloring pages, one design per page
• 2 pdf files: US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) and A4, 20 pages each
• The art is the same size on both papers, inside a rounded frame with a safe white margin, so home printers won't cut it off

HOW TO USE
• Print at 100% (actual size) on plain paper for crayons and pencils, or on card stock for markers and paint
• Print one page or all 20, as many times as you like
• Lovely for Christmas break, classroom parties, quiet time, church and library groups, Advent activities and cozy nights in

GOOD TO KNOW
• The colored examples in the photos are there to give you ideas; the files are black and white line art
• Colors on screen and paper vary with your printer

LICENSE
Personal use: print as many copies as you like for your own home, family and classroom. Please don't share, resell or redistribute the files or printed pages.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. The files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP from Duskwood Designs Co. Printing and paper are not included.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand.
